plan.title: ptbot sweep:auto — TOML-free cloud sweep orchestrator
plan.summary: Add a `ptbot sweep:auto` subcommand that takes sectors, geography, and years as CLI flags (no TOML file needed), dispatches parallel cloud agents to sweep all missing market×year combinations, and reports how many deals were added to the database.
plan.motivation: The existing `ptbot-sweep --cloud` requires authoring a TOML config file. `sweep:auto` removes that friction: declare what you want inline, fire cloud agents in parallel, and let the DB build itself. Primary use case: an operator or Oz agent can say `ptbot sweep:auto --sectors 'FinTech,HealthTech' --geography 'United States' --years 5` and walk away.
deliverables: New `ptbot sweep:auto` early-dispatch handler in cli.py with flags: --sectors (comma-separated), --geography, --years (default 5), --environment (Oz env id), --db-path, --max-workers (default 4), --dry-run
Builds a SweepConfig programmatically from flags (no TOML needed) and calls run_sweep(..., cloud=True) with the existing parallel executor
Progress output: shows dispatched/skipped/completed counts; waits for all ThreadPoolExecutor futures before returning
Graceful --dry-run mode: prints what would run without invoking any agents
Tests in tests/test_sweep_auto.py covering: single sector, multi-sector, dry-run, max-workers, --db-path respects override
README: add ## Auto-populating the database section with sweep:auto examples
constraints: Reuses existing run_sweep(), SweepConfig, make_cloud_runner() — no duplication
Frozen models — do not change DealCandidate or ResearchParams
Must work with max_workers > 1 (parallelism is the point)
--sectors accepts comma-separated list; each becomes a MarketTarget with the shared --geography
